articles.title: Anthropic joins AI’s natural gas frenzy, buys $3.4B worth of turbines | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Anthropic bought billions of dollars worth of natural gas turbines in a deal that could give it buyer's remorse.
articles.body_text: AI’s power crunch has become so acute that Anthropic, a company that has generally avoided buying physical infrastructure, is spending $3.4 billion on natural gas turbines. The AI company, which is planning to go public this year, is buying Caterpillar generators that equipment supplier OnePWR had originally ordered, according to a Financial Times report . The generators are capable of producing up to 1.7 gigawatts of electricity. Historically, Anthropic has preferred to rent rather than buy. The company disclosed in its S-1 filing in May that it is paying SpaceX subsidiary xAI $1.25 billion per month through May 2029 to use xAI’s computing power. “We expect to enter into additional similar services contracts,” Anthropic stated in the filing, meaning more deals to rent computing power. But as demand for compute ramps up, the market for power has also grown increasingly uncertain, which may have forced its hand. The backlog for natural gas turbines stretches into the early 2030s, and queues to connect to the electrical grid can be just as long. Anthropic’s purchase looks like a last resort. According to the report, OnePWR ordered the turbines a couple years ago, but couldn’t find financing to complete the purchase. Anthropic had planned to buy them from OnePWR but instead went directly to Caterpillar, the manufacturer. It’s not clear why OnePWR was unable to secure financing despite Anthropic’s apparent interest as a customer. Whatever the case, Anthropic likely wanted to keep the generating capacity to itself rather than give a competitor an opportunity to snap it up. AI companies have been ramping up their purchases of natural gas equipment and supplies in recent years. Google , Amazon , Microsoft , and Meta have all announced plans to build massive natural gas power plants to power their data centers on site, rather than drawing from the public grid. The binge has given a second wind to fracking , the drilling method used to extract natural gas from underground rock. And if the buildout proceeds as planned, U.S. data centers alone could consume more natural gas than Germany and Japan combined by 2035. The reliance on natural gas also exposes hyperscalers to price fluctuations. One analyst expects that prices could more than triple by the end of the decade in some markets. If that happens, Anthropic might have a serious case of buyer’s remorse. When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission . articles.title: Medium's new TK app brings AI assistance directly into the writing process | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Medium's new writing app embraces AI-assisted writing, despite growing controversy over the technology's role in publishing.
articles.body_text: Online publishing platform Medium on Monday launched a new app, called TK, which aims to bring AI technology deeper into the writing process. The idea behind TK is to make it easier to turn ideas into written words by incorporating an AI assistant into the editor itself, allowing users to ask for help by typing “@TK” followed by their request or prompt. In publishing and journalism, the term “TK” serves as a placeholder used to mark where missing information can be added later. The “TK” stands for “to come,” but uses a “K” instead of “C” as there are few English words where the “tk” letter combination exists, making it stand out more easily in written text where it could be caught by proofreaders. In Medium’s app , TK takes on a new role as it tries to help users fill in the blanks. The company suggests the AI assistant could help answer questions that you might normally have to switch to another tab to quickly look up, like how many days are in a particular month. The app could also pull in bits of writing you had previously saved to the app when you were still fleshing out your ideas. In addition, Medium says TK will ship with particular skills for editorial feedback, headline feedback, and others that could match your draft to the style guide for Medium publications. Medium’s move to embrace AI in the early stages of writing could prove controversial at a time when the publishing and literary worlds have been reckoning with the role that artificial intelligence has played in the creation of new long-form prose. Multiple authors have lost book deals over suspicions that they used AI technology to help them write, while other literary awards have come under scrutiny after winners were suspected of writing with AI assistance . While writers have long used automated tools for proofreading and light grammatical edits, there is growing concern across the publishing industry that an AI assistant’s editorial “suggestions” can become the writing itself, instead of being reflective of the thoughts in the writer’s own mind. But because AI models were trained on human writing, there are also questions around the reliability of AI detection tools in terms of their ability to properly determine when something was written with AI, rather than with its assistance, versus not at all. TK leans into this debate, taking the side that these nuances will ultimately no longer matter in the end. Instead, the company celebrates what AI can bring to the world of writing, saying that “artificial intelligence makes writing more important, not less,” and proclaiming that “AI is a technology that has the power to amplify human intelligence and it uses the written word as a foundation.” Still, Medium concedes that AI does raise the possibility of low-quality content and blurring the line between what’s human-written versus AI-written. To address these concerns, TK allows authors to publish notes that transparently explain how AI was used in their writing. “This is a start of what we believe is required to publish in the AI era, which is to make the provenance of writing clear, transparent, and inspectable, right down to the prompting and source material,” Medium explained in a blog post about the launch. In addition to writing assistance, TK will help users remember and organize what they had previously written and suggest writing prompts. The app can also optionally connect to your own AI agent through TK’s MCP server or Claude skill, so the app can better understand your projects, your positions, and other ideas that could be stored in your agent’s memory.

articles.title: Waymo robotaxis kept illegally passing school buses after software fix, feds say | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The update to Waymo's self-driving system was rolled out nearly a year ago.
articles.body_text: Nearly a year ago, Waymo updated its self-driving software and issued a recall after numerous reports that its robotaxis were illegally passing school buses that had stopped and deployed flashing red lights. Now, federal safety regulators have opened a new investigation into why that behavior has continued. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said in a November 6 filing that a majority of these reported incidents occurred after the company deployed a software update intended to fix the problem. Reuters was the first to report the filing. Waymo said last year that a software update was completed for all affected vehicles on November 17, 2025. However, NHTSA said the majority of the incidents occurred after the software update. NHTSA’s Office of Defects Investigation (ODI) has opened a “recall query” to “assess the adequacy of the remedy.” The ODI opened its initial investigation into Waymo in October 2025 after seeing footage of one of its autonomous vehicles maneuvering around a stopped school bus that had its stop sign extended, lights flashing, and was unloading children in Atlanta. In that incident, a Waymo robotaxi crossed perpendicularly in front of the school bus from its right side. The autonomous vehicle then turned left around the front of the bus before traveling down the street. Numerous other incidents have been documented in the weeks and months since in Austin, where Waymo also operates a robotaxi service. Austin Independent School District officials reported at least five such incidents at the time, according to a letter filed with NHTSA. Reached for comment, Waymo stressed the importance of safety to its mission. “We have made significant improvements to vehicle behavior around school buses and have received no citations since March 2026,” a spokesperson told TechCrunch via email. “The Waymo Driver has a clearly demonstrated positive impact on roadway safety. Once received, we’ll work to respond to NHTSA’s query and look forward to continuing our engagement on recall processes for AV software that continues to learn and improve.” TechCrunch also reached out to Austin Independent School District officials for comment and will update the article if they respond. articles.title: Meet Drops, the new music app bringing back the fun of sharing songs with friends | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The new music discovery app lets users scroll through 10- to 30-second snippets of songs, comment, and share with friends.
articles.body_text: There’s a new music discovery app borrowing the endless vertical-scrolling format of TikTok. But instead of watching videos, users swipe through short clips of songs, hoping to stumble upon their next favorite artist. Launched Monday by Harman , a Samsung subsidiary, Drops aims to make discovering new music feel social again. Available on iOS and Android in the U.S., the app lets users scroll through 10- to 30-second snippets of songs, accompanied by lyrics, album artwork, artist photos, and captions. The idea is to give listeners just enough of a track to grab their attention, whether it’s a particularly good lyric, a catchy hook, or a beat that makes them want to hear more. The company says Drops is meant to feel like a return to how people used to discover music in the first place. Before every platform’s algorithm recommendations, people often heard about new songs through friends, music blogs, or online communities. Drops is trying to recreate that experience. “You send a friend a song and say, ‘You have to hear this.’ Then you end up texting, ‘Skip to 1:47, that’s the best part.’ The part that hits usually isn’t the first few seconds, and there wasn’t a good way to share just that moment,” Clare Hunter, general manager of Drops, told us. Hunter explained that the idea for Drops began taking shape after Harman acquired music management software company Roon in 2023. “I used to spend hours making mixtapes for my friends, picking the songs, the order, and decorating the cover. Drops is the version of that I always wanted,” Hunter added. The app is easy to navigate, with tabs including “For You,” “New,” “Showcase,” and “Following,” along with relevant and trending hashtags. Users can like, comment, repost, share, and save tracks to collections called Droplists. They can also send songs directly to other users, follow other profiles, and exchange direct messages. To listen to the entire track, Drops offers integrations with major streaming services, including Apple Music, Qobuz, and TIDAL. Users can jump directly into the full version of the song through their connected streaming platform. Notably, the company says it doesn’t use generative AI for audio or visuals. Songs appear as they were originally released, using official album artwork and licensed artist photography. At a time when AI-generated music and slop are becoming harder to avoid, this will likely appeal to many users. Another part worth noting is that Drops pays rights holders and reports plays back to its partners. Those partners include Universal Music Group, Beggars Group, Empire, Symphonic Distribution, and UnitedMasters.

articles.title: Musk says Tesla will refund some Cybertruck deposits, defends decision to end production | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Elon Musk defended the company's decision to stop making the Cybertruck, which will go out of production in around eight months.
articles.body_text: Tesla CEO Elon Musk is defending the Cybertruck and the company’s decision to stop producing the polarizing steel-clad truck, claiming that the order rate far exceeds its production. Tesla will shut down production of the Cybertruck in about eight months Musk said in an X post on Monday. He also said the company will try to make as many of the vehicles as possible before then, though Tesla will “have to return deposits for a lot of people.” Musk argued the Cybertruck was not unprofitable, and that Tesla was ending production because the “opportunity cost of the complexity of Cybertruck is vastly outweighed by the value of incremental Cybercab production.” In other words, Musk is arguing that Tesla can make more money by using the factory space and resources dedicated to the Cybertruck for building Cybercab robotaxis. Musk said last week that Tesla plans to use the factory space to build more two-seater Cybercabs. The first Cybertrucks were delivered to customers in late 2023, when it seemed like it could be a breakthrough hit for the company. Reservations for the vehicle had ballooned to 1 million, according to Musk , who also predicted that the company would sell around 250,000 of the trucks annually. But those reservations never translated into actual sales. Tesla doesn’t break out sales of the Cybertrucks, but industry experts estimate a total of about 71,000 Cybertrucks have been sold since the first deliveries began in November 2023. Many of those sales came from inside Musk’s ecosystem of other businesses. For instance, SpaceX (now known as SpaceXSI), which he also leads and is the largest shareholder of, purchased $131 million worth of Cybertrucks from Tesla in 2025, according to the company’s S-1 registration statement ahead of its IPO. Another Musk company, xAI, also bought $430 million worth of Tesla Megapacks for its data centers, before it merged with SpaceX. But sales of the Cybertruck, which lagged for months, could see a final bump now that it’s going out of production. Still, even a scarcity boost is unlikely to push the truck’s demand to the lofty projections from several years ago. When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission . articles.title: Is Jensen Huang’s job on the line? Yale’s Jeffrey Sonnenfeld estimates it’s 'about a 50-50' | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Nvidia’s board is investigating Jensen Huang over his relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, and Yale’s Jeffrey Sonnenfeld thinks it’s roughly a coin flip whether Huang stays on as CEO.
articles.body_text: Nvidia’s board announced Sunday that it’s launching an independent investigation after CEO Jensen Huang told staff he was unfaithful to his wife. But this isn’t a case of just another CEO having an extramarital affair. The romantic interest is Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom U.S. officials believe is a Chinese spy who was feeding information back to Beijing. In short, the stakes reach well beyond Nvidia, given how many tech and financial partners depend on its place at the center of the AI economy. “I’m responsible for an entire industry ,” Huang recently told Bloomberg in a sit-down. A spokesperson for the Chinese Embassy in Washington dismissed the allegations in late October as “ groundless smears and slanders ,” and no one has been charged. But U.S. intelligence officials reportedly briefed President Donald Trump about their concerns a year ago, and unnamed senior officials inside the Trump administration told the Times that they doubt Huang could have remained unaware all that time of Alice Huang’s intelligence-gathering role for China. When Trump was first briefed, the Times reported, officials didn’t believe Huang knew, and it isn’t clear whether their assessment has changed. The board, meanwhile, says it sees no sign that national security or company secrets were compromised. The question is whether Huang can survive this. To think through what could come next, this editor spoke Sunday with famed professor Jeffrey Sonnenfeld, senior associate dean for leadership studies at the Yale School of Management and founder of the Chief Executive Leadership Institute, which has hosted Huang at its CEO summits. Sonnenfeld likes Huang, he said, and he called Huang’s career salvageable but put the odds at “about a 50-50.” He also had a lot more food for thought. First, the damage. Until now, Huang has been “revered and trusted by everybody in technology,” Sonnenfeld noted. But he called this episode “remarkably poor judgment.” Even if Huang was merely naive, he said, “any employee in Nvidia other than him would be fired over this,” and the recklessness alone would mean “an irretrievable loss of confidence.” Sonnenfeld suggested that Huang’s saving grace could be what social psychologists call idiosyncrasy credits , if he can prove he was being duped. The term comes from Edwin Hollander, a social psychologist who proposed in a 1958 paper that people earn latitude in a group by showing competence and following its rules. Huang has been earning latitude since he co-founded Nvidia in 1993. But all that goodwill can run out when a screw-up looks self-serving or touches the group’s core norms. Here that group includes Nvidia’s board, its roughly 42,000 employees who are bound by security rules, and, in a looser sense, the U.S. government, given it restricts its exports. We also talked about precedents, except, as it turns out, there really are none for what’s unfolding right now. Executives who survive personal scandals sometimes pick up where they left off at another company, Sonnenfeld observed. Former HP CEO Mark Hurd is one example. Between 2005 and 2010, he drove HP to the top of the tech industry by revenue, then was pressured to resign after he filed inaccurate expense reports that hid a personal relationship with a contractor. Oracle hired him about a month later. Huang has no equivalent because Nvidia is his company As for the bench at Nvidia, that doesn’t really exist either. While there is typically a hierarchy inside companies of Nvidia’s scale and importance, Huang has kept things as flat as possible, with about 60 direct reports by his own account. That structure makes it hard to figure out who would succeed him (though his children, both of whom work at Nvidia, are sometimes the subject of succession speculation ). That won’t stop the worldwide guessing game that’s sure to follow. And boards in crisis often reach for a “messianic solution” from outside, Sonnenfeld said, floating former Google CEO Eric Schmidt as one idea. Nvidia’s role at the center of a massive and complex circular financing web is what makes this particular predicament so tricky and, undoubtedly, terrifying for a wide number of constituents. Nvidia isn’t just the biggest provider of chips driving the AI boom but also largely the bank behind the buildout. In addition to stakes in hundreds of smaller startups, Nvidia has invested in OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, CoreWeave and Nebius. In August, it also signed preliminary agreements with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR aimed at mobilizing more than $500 billion over time, and Huang has said Nvidia could backstop up to a quarter of it. The move was widely interpreted as a way to spread risk. Now, a leadership crisis at the center is how a stumble becomes a collapse. So what’s Nvidia’s board likely doing at this moment? Sonnenfeld noted that Huang’s constant, public advocacy for selling advanced chips to China had already made people anxious. Anthropic’s Dario Amodei, whose company Nvidia has backed, had a lot to say about selling chips to China at Davos back in January, likening it to “ selling nuclear weapons to North Korea .” Now the board’s independent members — meaning everyone but Huang — will have to establish what technology reached China if any, and by what routes, including by better understanding Nvidia’s relationship with Megaspeed. The Singapore cloud company, which grew out of a Chinese gaming business and became Nvidia’s largest buyer in Southeast Asia, bought roughly $2 billion of its chips , The New York Times reported in October 2025, raising broader questions about whether it was helping China circumvent U.S. export restrictions by re-exporting the chips to China or renting them to Chinese customers remotely. (An Nvidia spokesperson told The Hill after the Times report that the allegations were “thoroughly investigated and debunked last year .”) In the meantime, Huang will keep running the company, Nvidia said Sunday. That’ll be a tall order, even for a CEO who already spends much of his time traveling the world to promote Nvidia. For starters, three House chairmen want a closed-door briefing from Huang on November 18. Nvidia is also reporting its newest earnings on November 17. Sonnenfeld expects that even if Huang keeps the title, he’ll have to hand off some of the day-to-day decision-making. Only one thing is certain right now. Huang doesn’t own the kind of super-voting stock that would cement his power at Nvidia. Sonnenfeld often argues for dual-class structures that empower founders, and he says Huang’s success without one has been the best counterargument to that case. But if Huang had one, Sonnenfeld continued, removing him would be harder.

articles.title: Apps to distract you from the endless cycle of doomscrolling | TechCrunch
articles.summary: It's hard to break the cycle of doomscrolling, but there are plenty of apps that can help you spend more time on content that’s engaging and productive.
articles.body_text: You open your phone to check the time or a quick message. The next thing you know, an hour has passed and you’ve scrolled through endless celebrity drama, cat videos, awful news stories, influencer rants, and whatever else the algorithm decided to throw at you. Even though you probably don’t want to keep wasting your time and energy on this mind-numbing content, you do it again the next day. Doomscrolling, the habit of spending excessive amounts of time consuming content on social media, has become incredibly widespread. A survey from last year found that 64% of Americans say they doomscroll . Researchers have warned that doomscrolling can negatively affect several aspects of your well-being, including your mental health and attention span. Spending long periods scrolling can lead to brain fatigue, difficulty focusing, and disrupted sleep. And if a lot of the content you’re consuming is negative or stressful, it can leave you feeling disheartened , anxious, and emotionally drained. It’s hard to break the cycle of doomscrolling, but there are plenty of apps that provide content that’s engaging and productive. Of course, you could always read a book or go for a walk (we have a guide on how to stop doomscrolling ), but this list is for when you have a few spare minutes and want something to do on your phone that isn’t endless scrolling. Finch is a self-care pet app that’s designed to help you build healthy habits. You care for a cute virtual pet by completing small daily goals, such as drinking enough water, going on a walk, and practicing mindfulness. You can write about your day, complete a breathing exercise, or send good vibes to a friend by adding them to the app. The more self-care you do, the more your pet thrives. The app offers a fun way to trade mindless scrolling for small moments of self-care. Finch is available for free on iOS and Android . Libby is a free reading app that connects you to your local public library’s digital collection of ebooks, audiobooks, and magazines. All you need is a library card to borrow thousands of titles, which makes it easy to turn screen time into something productive. You can explore a new book during a commute or while waiting at a doctor’s office, turning moments when your fingers might otherwise itch to scroll into opportunities to read. Libby is available for free on iOS and Android .

articles.title: Nvidia will investigate CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with possible Chinese spy | TechCrunch
articles.summary: In a memo to the company, Huang admitted that he had an affair.
articles.body_text: Nvidia’s board of directors announced Sunday that it’s launching an independent investigation following reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a Chinese spy operation . Nvidia also published a message that Huang sent to the company admitting that he had an affair with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based chip company Megaspeed (though he didn’t mention her by name). A memo circulating among U.S. policymakers earlier this year claimed that Alice Huang had been recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security to spy on Nvidia’s CEO. “I owe my family and all of you an apology,” Jensen Huang wrote. “I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.” Huang added that he’d “fallen short” of his responsibility to the company. “To my colleagues at NVIDIA, including those I have worked alongside for decades, and to our board, partners, and shareholders around the world: you deserve better from me,” he said. As the AI race between the United States and China heats up , chips, especially Nvidia’s chips, have been a major focus . Huang also seems to have a close relationship with President Donald Trump , who’s been a cheerleader of the AI ( or “superintelligence” ) industry. In its announcement, Nvidia’s board said that it has “no reason to believe” that either national security or company secrets were compromised. It also said that Huang “fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it,” and that the board has “confidence in Jensen and his leadership team.” The investigation will be conducted by independent directors working with outside legal counsel. In response to earlier reports about the CEO’s relationship with Alice Huang, Nvidia had said that the pair’s interactions were “not unusual,” and that the company does not share classified information with customers. Other companies involved in the AI boom have warned employees to be wary of possible spies , including those offering sex or romance. articles.title: Sequoia partners reportedly blindsided when Roelof Botha joined SpaceX board | TechCrunch
articles.summary: A new report claims Sequoia's recent changes undo the legacy of the firm's former steward.
articles.body_text: Sequoia Capital announced some major changes this week, including the closure of its London office, the merger of its early-stage and growth teams, and the end of its Scouts program . Now, the Financial Times has published a report painting all of this as an attempt to undo the legacy of former leader Roelof Botha, who stepped down as the firm’s steward last year . An unnamed source told the FT that Botha “loved process and hierarchy,” while “the rest of the team didn’t.” Apparently, not everyone is on-board with the changes, with another source firing back that this seems like an “erasure of Sequoia’s heritage, not Roelof’s legacy.” The break between Botha and his old firm reportedly deepened after Botha joined the SpaceX board this summer. (Botha and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk previously worked together at PayPal.) A source told the FT that Sequoia’s partners were blindsided by the announcement, because Botha “didn’t ask compliance, he didn’t get sign off from the partnership” — even though his new role could complicate the firm’s ability to trade its $20 billion stake. A Sequoia spokesperson said that the firm continues to “collaborate closely” with Botha. articles.title: 3D DRAM created by IBM and Micron, 128GBps memory on the way
articles.summary: Smaller and faster RAM with up to 128GB transfer speed scould be on the way thanks to research from IBM and MIcron, using stacked chips and TSVs.
articles.body_text: Smaller and faster RAM with up to 128GBps transfer speeds could be on the way thanks to research from IBM and MIcron. The companies have developed three-dimensional memory, stacking individual DRAM chips vertically that would normally have to be placed side-by-side, though the efficiencies gained aren’t solely down to space. Communication between the stacked chips and the host device is achieved through a new creation known as through-silicon vias, or TSVs, which run vertically through the pile of chips and act as conduits to the host device. Thanks to the TSVs, in testing the memory has reached data speeds of 128GBps, ten times faster than current memory. On top of this, IBM claims the chips are 70 percent more power efficient than today’s DRAM. The new research is expected to form a key part of Samsung and Micron’s Hybrid Memory Cube technology, first announced back in October. IBM and Micron hope to have commercial availability in two years, with servers likely to use it first. Looking beyond that, IBM fellow Subu Iyer said that the new process “will have applications beyond memory, enabling other industry segments as well.” What exactly those new segments are remains to be seen, but we certainly wouldn’t complain if our computers got the kind of speed bump described here.

En pappa i South Carolina lämnade sin sovande sexåriga dotter ensam. De köade för att köpa nya Pokémonkort – pappan ville inte tappa sin plats. Pappan greps av polis och misstänks nu för brott mot barn. Sent i fredags i Charleston, South Carolina, köade folk utanför en Target-butik för att bli först med att köpa nya versionen av Pokémon -spelet ”Mega evolution – delta reign”. Vid halv tre anlände polis till platsen efter att larm inkommit om ett övergivet barn. I kön hittade de en sexårig flicka som kommit dit tillsammans med sin pappa. Men när flickan somnat vid klockan ett på natten hade pappan, enligt vad andra på platsen berättat, gett henne en kudde och en filt – och gått hem. Först flera timmar senare kom han tillbaka med en förklaring som skapat rubriker i amerikanska medier.

articles.title: Lundsbergs rektor lämnar skolan: ”Går i pension”
articles.summary: Rektorn på Lundsbergs internatskola, Lars Jonsson, lämnar. Enligt ett pressmeddelande ska han gå i pension.
articles.body_text: Rektorn på Lundsbergs internatskola, Lars Jonsson, lämnar. Enligt ett pressmeddelande ska han gå i pension. – Jag vill rikta ett varmt tack till honom för hans starka engagemang och hans goda insatser för att driva på en modernisering av Lundsberg, säger styrelsens ordförande Peter Morfeldt. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Lundsbergsskolans verksamhetschef Lars Jonsson lämnar sitt uppdrag. I ett pressmeddelande skriver styrelsen att han ska gå i pension. Jonsson blev ansiktet utåt för skolan när den så kallade ”januariincidenten” blev en nationell nyhet. Fyra internatelever dömdes för misshandel och grovt hemfridsbrott mot yngre elever i en hämndaktion för en ”rap battle”. Efter att SVT:s Dokument inifrån publicerat en dokumentär om misshandeln och internatet växte kritiken mot skolan. Lars Jonsson, som var rektor på skolan under den tiden, tog mycket av det mediala ansvaret. Nu meddelar skolans styrelse att han lämnar på egen begäran för att gå i pension. Michael Lisberg kommer ta över som verksamhetschef. – Jag ser fram emot att tillsammans med elever och medarbetare bygga vidare på allt det fina som finns på Lundsberg – samtidigt som vi behöver vara öppna för att fortsätta förändra det som måste bli bättre, säger Michael Lisberg i ett pressmeddelande. Styrelsens ordförande, Peter Morfeldt, riktar ett tack till den avgående verksamhetschefen Lars Jonsson – För hans starka engagemang och hans goda insatser för att driva på en modernisering av Lundsberg. Jag önskar honom allt gott framöver, säger Morfeldt.

articles.title: V-veteranens varning: Katastrofalt att fega ur

articles.body_text: Vänsterpartiet har tydliga krav: att sitta i regering eller rösta rött. Och enligt V-veteraner är det lönlöst att byta kurs. – Det vore rent katastrofalt att fega ur när det verkligen gäller, säger tidigare V-ledamoten Stig Henriksson. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Med 176 mandat har de rödgröna partierna majoritet. De har dock ett problem. Vänsterpartiet vill sitta i regering – Socialdemokraterna vill inte att de gör det. Magdalena Andersson har i stället utlovat sakpolitiskt inflytande om V väljer att agera stödparti. Enligt den tidigare V-riksdagsledamoten Stig Henriksson har partiet dock ingenting att tjäna på att släppa ministerkravet. – Det handlar inte posterna om i sig, utan att det ger enorma möjligheter att utforma politik. Det är vackert att skriva ett papper några veckor efter valet om vad man är överens om, men det papperet förlorar i betydelse för varje dag som går, säger han. Vänsterpartiet har markerat att deras linje – att rösta ner varje regering man inte ingår i – kvarstår. Den är även förankrad i ett kongressbeslut. Ingen vet hur ett extraval skulle sluta – däremot blir konsekvenserna ”katastrofala” i det kommande ordinarie valet om V viker sig nu, resonerar Henriksson. – Varför ska man någonsin rösta på Vänsterpartiet om vi ändå agerar dörrmatta åt sossarna? Då kan man lika gärna rösta på dem på en gång. Vi har levt i hundratio år av ensamhet och bara varit passiva stödjare. Fortsätter vi med det så får vi hundratio år till, säger Henriksson.

articles.title: V: Hoppar av rödgröna möten
articles.summary: Vänsterpartiet ställer in redan inplanerade möten med de rödgröna partierna. Det kommer efter Magdalena Anderssons regeringsbesked i går.
articles.body_text: Inplanerade möten med de rödgröna partierna har ställts in. Det kommer efter Magdalena Anderssons (S) regeringsbesked i går. – Nu har Magdalena Andersson gett besked att vi inte ingår i hennes regering. Alla dessa frågor behöver ställas till henne, säger V-ledaren Nooshi Dadgostar. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Flera inplanerade möten med de fyra rödgröna partierna har ställts in. Det bekräftar Vänsterpartiets vice partiledare Ida Gabrielsson för TV4 Nyheterna , som tidigare rapporterade om det med hänvisning till källor. Beskedet kommer efter Magdalena Anderssons (S) pressträff i går där hon meddelade att hon kommer jobba för en C, S och MP-regering i tätt samarbete med V. Men det har V uteslutit sedan partiet tog ett kongressbeslut om saken. Deras krav är fortsatt att sitta i regering eller gå i full opposition. Meningen med mötena mellan de fyra partierna skulle vara att diskutera en möjlig regeringsbildning. Men V kommer inte dyka upp. Gabrielsson säger att det i grund och botten är Centerpartiets besked om att se över ett högersamarbete som gör att de ställer in sin medverkan. – Man öppnar upp för att göra sig beroende av Sverigedemokraternas mandat och byta statsministerkandidat efter valet, säger hon i TV4:s Nyhetsdagen. Partiledare Nooshi Dadgostar säger till Expressen att det inte är hon som ställt in mötena, och att alla frågor bör riktas till Magdalena Andersson eftersom V ”inte ingår i hennes regering” . – Nu har Magdalena Andersson gett besked att vi inte ingår i hennes regering. Alla dessa frågor behöver ställas till henne, säger Dadgostar.

articles.title: S-toppen sätter press på C: Då har de lurat väljarna
articles.summary: Frustrationen stiger i Socialdemokraterna. Elfva Barrio, S-studenters ordförande, tycker C kommer för lätt undan. – Går de högerut har de lurat väljarna.
articles.body_text: Frustrationen kring regeringsbildningen stiger i Socialdemokraterna. Elfva Barrio, S-studenters ordförande, tycker att C kommer för lätt undan. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. På söndagen meddelade Magdalena Andersson (S) att hon vill bilda regering med Centerpartiet och Miljöpartiet , med stöd av Vänsterpartiet. Samtidigt som hon nobbar V-kravet på ministerposter öppnar hon för politiska eftergifter till V och tjänstemän i regeringskansliet. Hittills har dock V helt avfärdat dessa tankar. Detta har fått många i S att reagera starkt. Bland dem finns Elfva Barrio. S-studenter , som brukar räknas till S vänsterfalang, har hoppats på politik där S och V står nära varandra, och är nu rädd att den ska gå om intet. Som exempel nämner hon fler bostäder för unga och avskaffad marknadsskola. Därför vädjar Elfva Barrio till V att tänka om. – Vänsterpartiet har ett guldläge att få genom politik nu, säger hon. Men Barrios frustration riktar sig också mot Centerpartiet, som just nu väljer mellan en regering ledd av Magdalena Andersson eller en ledd av Ulf Kristersson (M). En regering till höger riskerar att bli beroende av SD:s stöd, något C sade tydligt nej till före valet. Att välja det alternativet vore att ”lura väljarna”, enligt Barrio.

articles.title: AI-jätten rasar på börsen
articles.summary: Vd:n och grundaren Jensen Huangs otrohetsskandal skakar om världens näst största företag – chipjätten Nvidia. articles.body_text: Vd:n och grundaren Jensen Huangs otrohetsskandal skakar om världens näst största företag – chipjätten Nvidia. Bolaget förlorar flera tusen miljarder kronor i börsvärde när aktien faller dramatiskt. Men Huang lär inte få sparken, spår kapitalförvaltaren Kristofer Barrett som länge följt bolaget. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Det är en historia som skulle kunna ligga till grund för en Hollywoodfilm. Vd:n för ett av världens största bolag har erkänt en otrohetsaffär med Alice Huang vid företaget Megaspeed. Hon och hennes företag har gjort affärer med Nvidia samtidigt som hon misstänks vara en kinesisk spion som har agerat på uppdrag av Kina. Nvidias styrelse har tillsatt en utredning. – Det är tråkigt att behöva prata om folks privatliv i affärskontext, men det är bekräftat från företaget att han har varit otrogen mot sin familj. Det som inte är bekräftat är att det ska vara en spion, säger Kristofer Barrett till TT. Som fondförvaltare vid kapitalförvaltaren Carmignac har Kristofer Barrett följt Huang och Nvidia sedan starten. Han har även träffat honom som hastigast vid några tillfällen. – Det är tråkigt för Huangs familj, det är tråkigt för bolaget, men jag tror inte det kommer att bli så allvarligt. Det är bara rykten vad den här kvinnan har haft för relation och syften, säger han. Från marknadshåll har reaktionen varit omedelbar. Vid eftermiddagens börsöppning på Wall Street faller Nvidiaaktien omkring 8 procent, vilket innebär att ett marknadsvärde på flera tusen miljarder kronor är utraderat. I sin position som näst största bolag i världen, efter Apple, väger också aktien tungt i olika index- och pensionsfonder. Otrohetsskandalen briserar samtidigt som hela AI-sektorn de senaste veckorna skakats av kraftiga kursfall och ifrågasättanden av om värderingarna i bolagen är alltför optimistiska. Att de här uppgifterna kring Huang kommit fram just nu bedömer Barrett kan kopplas till ”politiska undertoner”, men han vill inte gå in på detaljer om vad han menar. USA och Kina har under en längre tid haft en kapplöpning kring AI-utveckling. Utifrån konkurrenssituationen har det också varit en känslig fråga i vilken omfattning Nvidia ska få sälja sina chip till kunder i Kina. Avslöjandet kring Huang har också väckt frågor om nationell säkerhet utifrån betydelsen av Nvidia för amerikansk del.

articles.title: Sjuksköterska våldtog döende patient – döms
articles.summary: En manlig sjuksköterska våldtog en döende patient på Länssjukhuset Ryhov. ha blivit upptäckt tog han till flykt – och kraschade sin bil under en polisjakt.
articles.body_text: En manlig sjuksköterska våldtog en döende patient på Länssjukhuset Ryhov. Efter att ha blivit upptäckt av en kollega tog han till flykt – och kraschade sin bil under en polisjakt. Nu döms han till fängelse i fem år och åtta månader. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. En sjuksköterska döms för att ha våldtagit en svårt sjuk kvinna på Länssjukhuset Ryhov i Jönköping . Han får fem år och åtta månaders fängelse. – Tingsrätten har gjort bedömningen att brottet ska bedömas som grov våldtäkt och att brottet har ett straffvärde som överstiger straffminimum, säger rådmannen Johanna Syrén i ett pressmeddelande. Tingsrätten bedömer brottet som grovt då han utnyttjat sin ställning som sjuksköterska och kvinnan saknat möjlighet att försvara sig. Han upptäcktes inne i kvinnans rum av en kollega sent på kvällen den 8 augusti. Enligt hans egen utsago hade han tagit av sig tröjan och dragit ner byxorna och kalsongerna innan han la sig i kvinnans säng. När kollegan fick syn på honom och frågade vad han höll på med steg han snabbt ur sängen. Han försökte sedan fly från sjukhuset med bil. Det inleddes en polisjakt och han kraschade bilen strax efter i ett betongfundament på E4. För det döms han även för grov vårdslöshet i trafik. Den kvinnliga patienten, som var i 70-årsåldern, vårdades i livets slutskede och var inte vid medvetande under övergreppet. Hon avled några timmar efter händelsen. Dödsorsaken var hennes grundsjukdom, enligt den rättsmedicinska bedömningen.

articles.title: Hade fullt av gevär och nazistföremål
articles.summary: 31 vapen, en byst som föreställde Adolf Hitler, och diverse andra nazistföremål hittades hemma hos en Vimmerbybo i 35-årsåldern. Nu åtalas han för synnerligen grovt vapenbrott.
articles.body_text: 31 vapen, en byst som föreställde Adolf Hitler, och diverse andra nazistföremål hittades hemma hos en Vimmerbybo i 35-årsåldern. Förklaringen: Han tycker vapen är ”jävligt spännande”. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Dagen innan nyårsafton kontrollerade polisen i Vimmerby kommun en man som man misstänkte var påverkad av narkotika. Man tog beslut om husrannsakan och tog sig in i mannens bostad. Där hittade polisen en stor samling vapen – som mannen inte hade licens för. Även i en lagerlokal, som mannen haft tillgång till, gjordes beslag. Sammanlagt hittades 31 olika vapen, bland annat flera olika sorters gevär, pistoler och en kulspruta. Mer än 11 500 patroner hittades också i mannens ägo. I lägenheten fanns även flera föremål med kopplingar till nazismen. På en hylla i vardagsrummet stod bland annat en byst som föreställer Adolf Hitler, mössor och koppar med hakkorset på, och flera olika tygmärken med nazistiska symboler på. I lägenhetens gästrum hittade polisen en väggbonad med hakkorset och en nazistuniform som hängde på en klädställning. Ett flertal knivar, knogjärn och andra liknande föremål fanns också i bostaden. flera vapendelar och en stor mängd ammunition (drygt 11 500 patroner) Mannen åtalades för för synnerligen grovt vapenbrott och i veckan hölls rättegången i Kalmar tingsrätt. Den stora mängden vapen gör att åklagaren betraktar brottet som särskilt grovt. ” Gärningen har också varit av särskilt farlig art eftersom NN förvarat, hanterat och använt vapen och ammunition på sätt som innebar fara för att andra personer skulle komma till skada ”, skriver åklagaren i stämningsansökan. Domen meddelas den 10 november. Åklagaren har yrkat på minst sex års fängelse, skriver Vimmerby tidning.

articles.summary: Regeringsbildningen pressas framåt men kraven från partierna gör förhandlingarna ovanligt svåra
articles.body_text: Efter valresultatet har regeringsfrågan hamnat i ett politiskt dödläge. Socialdemokraterna vill se en regering utan V – men den tidigare S-ministern Leif Pagrotsky tror att det blir en alliansregering. – Nu gäller det att trampa på gasen, säger han i SVT Morgonstudion. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Socialdemokraternas partiledare Magdalena Andersson gjorde i söndags tydligt att hon vill se en regering bestående av S, MP och C – med stöd av V. I måndagens sändning av SVT Morgonstudion beskriver tidigare S-ministern Leif Pagrotsky regeringsförhandlingarna som ett ”chicken-race” mellan Vänsterpartiet och Centerpartiet. Han menar att de båda partiernas positioner gör det svårt att få ihop ett fungerande regeringsunderlag. – Hur det slutar, om det blir nyval eller om det blir en enpartiregering med socialdemokrater, eller en förnyad alliansregering... Jag skulle nog säga alliansregering, säger han i programmet. Även moderaten Hanif Bali medverkar i sändningen. Han tror att låsningen kan bli så svår att den slutar med ett extra val. – De kräver någon form av upphävande av matematikens lagar och förenandet av olja och vatten. Jag tror det blir svårt att få ihop för vem som helst egentligen, säger han. Leif Pagrotsky ser söndagens besked som ett sätt att föra regeringsprocessen framåt. Enligt honom handlar det om att gå från att känna av varandras positioner till att faktiskt börja driva på mot en lösning. – Man ska inte behandla det här som ett slutbesked. Nu gäller det att trampa på gasen, nu måste vi börja närma oss ett beslutsskede, säger han i Morgonstudion.

articles.body_text: Dödssiffran stiger efter explosionen på ett stålverk i Turkiet. Minst 16 personer har dött och 13 har skadats efter explosionen i den turkiska hamnstaden Izmir, uppger president Recep Tayyip Erdogan. Enligt Izmirs guvernör saknas åtta personer. Enligt hans kansli verkar orsaken till explosionen vara en kran som fallit ned över en anläggning som smälter stål. Bilder från platsen visar stora moln av mörk rök, men exakt vad som ledde till explosionen är ännu oklart, säger president Erdogan. – Omständigheterna till denna tragiska händelse, som hur och varför det hände, är oklara. Om någon var försumlig och vem som är ansvarig kommer att fastslås, säger Erdogan i ett tv-sänt tal. Centerpartiets ungdomsförbund (Cuf) konstaterar att "mitten är död" och att Centern måste gå vidare i regeringsförhandlingarna. "Senare i veckan ska S och M presentera sina totalpaket. Cuf kommer särskilt titta på hur de håller ytterkantspartierna borta från maktens centrum", skriver ordföranden Emelie Rossheim i en kommentar till TT. Cuf vill också att regeringsbildaren ska inkludera en "demokratiklausul" i förhandlingarna som ska ta hänsyn till minoritetsrättigheter, humanism, religionsfrihet, rättsstatens principer och internationell solidaritet. Enligt uppgifter till Le Figaro tror fransk underrättelsetjänst att Iran ligger bakom det cyberangrepp som höjde temperaturen i franska matbutikers kylar och frysar den 11-12 oktober. En liknande attack drabbade svenska livsmedelsbutiker förra veckan. Både ICA- och Coop-butiker fick slänga mängder med mat efter att temperaturen i frysarna hade höjts. Flera andra europeiska länder, såsom Italien, Storbritannien och Tyskland, utsattes också för angreppet. Svenskt näringsliv, LO och PTK har nått en ny överenskommelse om avtalspension, meddelar organisationerna i ett pressmeddelande. Den nya överenskommelsen gäller kollektivavtalad pension, försäkring och omställning för privatanställda tjänstemän och arbetare. Runt två miljoner svenskar berörs.
